subject.title: [Bug]: iMessage channel probe invokes unsupported `imsg status` with imsg 0.5.0

question: Should the bundled iMessage plugin continue supporting imsg 0.5.0, or should it require a newer imsg release and diagnose that requirement before the private-API probe runs?
rationale: The technical repair differs materially depending on whether the older upstream CLI is an active compatibility contract: compatibility needs an alternate probe, while an upgrade boundary needs a precise and tested operator diagnostic.

options.title: Require a newer imsg release
options.body: Define and document the minimum imsg version, then fail the advanced-action probe with a clear update instruction while retaining normal RPC messaging where supported.

options.title: Support imsg 0.5.0
options.body: Implement a version-aware alternate capability check and regression coverage for the older CLI command surface.

recommendation.title: Require a newer imsg release
recommendation.body: Define and document the minimum imsg version, then fail the advanced-action probe with a clear update instruction while retaining normal RPC messaging where supported.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the upstream imsg command contract and OpenClaw’s bundled iMessage integration.
